rule: Covariate-only nearest-cell rule: for each target I take the stored count(s) that share its model/edit, set, prompt, cap, sampling and seed, or differ in only one covariate, and adjust along that covariate using stored differences. These include: step-100/400 offsets from the 4-sample checkpoint means; cue-minus-plain gaps at the same checkpoint; the dial's stored cap-hit counts per edit scale times the stored right-of-finished share; layer-band totals minus the known sample; explore-half rows plus the test half scaled by a stored test/explore ratio; cap-32k gains from the Think-SFT and M2 cut-at-16k counts. Intervals widen when the nearest stored cell is further away in covariates (other reward, other module set, extrapolated scale), and are tight where a stored total pins the value arithmetically.
